// ------------------------------------------------------------
// PHASE 3 - Reversible edits to existing room events and registrations.
// No table additions occur after this point; EXPAND_UNDO offsets stay valid.
// Uninstall restores the original room slots, group list and variable bindings.
//
// Shared hangar registration
//
// - SeqEvent_HQUnits_X: retain the original 26 groups and append new eight groups
// - SeqAct_Interp_1: retain original bindings and append eight new bindings
// - Main_Sequence: retain original nodes and register sixteen new variables
// ------------------------------------------------------------
